measurement_type: official Play Store device integrity diagnostic (Play Integrity settings > Check integrity)
reason: The Play Store was signed out. The documented seven-tap unlock did not expose Developer options, so the Check integrity entry point was not present. No verdict labels were returned.
not_an_integrity_failure: An unavailable diagnostic is not evidence that the device failed BASIC, DEVICE, STRONG, or VIRTUAL integrity.

google_play_store.self_update_check: Google Play Store is up to date

attempts.action: Open Play Store overflow menu and Settings while signed out
attempts.observed: Settings, Updates, and Play Protect were reachable from the overflow menu.
Play Store version 54.3.07-34 was visible; Play Protect certification read 'Device is not certified'.

attempts.action: Tap the Play Store version row seven times
attempts.observed: No 'Developer options' entry appeared in Settings, General, or About. No unlock toast was present in the captured frame.

attempts.action: Request Play Store self-update and dismiss the result
attempts.observed: Play Store reported 'Google Play Store is up to date'.

attempts.action: Repeat seven semantic taps on the Play Store version row after relaunch
attempts.observed: Developer options and Check integrity remained absent.

exact_api_errors: UNAUTHENTICATED: Request is missing required authentication credential. Expected OAuth 2 access token, login cookie or other valid authentication credential.
ActivityManager: Scheduling restart of crashed service com.google.android.gms/.play.integrity.api.service.IntegrityApiPersistentService
independent_note: Google's procedure starts from the Play Store profile icon. In a signed-out Play Store the same Settings screen was reached through the overflow menu, so navigation itself was not the blocker. The documented developer-mode unlock is gated on an account; no organization-approved test account was available, and no account was created.
